_description: CCBee sound notification hooks for Claude Code. Copy the 'hooks' block into your settings.json (user-level: ~/.claude/settings.json, or project-level: <project>/.claude/settings.json). Replace <CCBEEP_DIR> with the absolute path to this project (e.g., /Users/you/projects/CCBeep or C:\Users\you\projects\CCBeep).

hooks._comment_UserPromptSubmit: Fires when user submits a prompt — plays a gentle sound to acknowledge input received.
hooks._comment_Notification: Fires on desktop notification events (task complete, etc.) — plays a completion chime.
hooks._comment_Stop: Fires when agent stops — the script reads stdin JSON to auto-detect error vs success and play the right sound.
